messages:
maya: Morning team — quick poll: who set the kitchen thermostat to `temperature:1.2`... I wake up to synthwave and a 90s dial-up hum :sweat_smile:
devon: guilty. thought 'higher temp = more creativity' would help me write prompts :grimacing:
sam: devon no. you can't just tune the office like an LLM hyperparam :rofl:
jin: to be fair, I did change it to `temperature:0.7` around lunch when the neural-offices got chatty
maya: @devon you owe us a pot of office coffee now :coffee: also please set it back to sane
stella: we should probably standardize an "office system prompt" for thermostat: `You are a regulatory thermostat: keep humans comfy, no hallucinations.`
devon: love that. can we add `avoid_thermostat_drift: true` to the prompt? :robot_face:
ops-bot: note recorded: "thermostat_policy = 'keep humans comfortable'". Scheduled check in 2 days :calendar:
sam: suggestion: we label the thermostat scale like models — `0.0 (Boring-Base)` -> `1.0 (Chatty-Pro)` -> `1.2 (Devon's Fork)`
maya: brilliant. stickers for the scale? :sticker: also who wants to write the prompt? I'll draft a silly one and hide it in the kitchen.
jin: i'll upvote anything that includes `no_on-prem_pings_after_6pm` :thumbsup:
stella: also can we get a poll: prefer 'office as assistant' or 'office as cofounder' vibe? tiny psychological experiment :eyes:
devon: poll please. I vote 'cofounder' — more permission for creative thermostat tuning :wink:
maya: poll now: https://tinyurl.com/office-temp-prompt — click so we can stop debating over Slack :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
